about: Quick reference: the model and profile to use for each rig lane and job. Other repos read this (through model_library.py) instead of choosing models themselves. Change a role only after a benchmark review; 'evidence' names the campaign behind it.

brain.why: Running brain model; Qwen3.8-27B is the next candidate.

brain_code.why: Leads MBPP+ base 87.8% vs 85.7%; code-only brain work.

split_quality.why: Split-worker quality and code; current full HumanEval+ base 87.8%, plus 82.3%, and BBH flexible 37.2%.
split_quality.evidence: ministral14b-full-gap-20261127; exact commands and scores in results/model_benchmark_records.jsonl

split_speed.why: Faster split lane for parallel import prep and code work; 20.39 generation tok/s versus 14B at 13.60 on the measured runtime task.
split_speed.evidence: role-bbh-ministral8b-20261127; role-runtime-full-gap-20261127; full code 2026-10-18; exact commands in results/model_benchmark_records.jsonl

single_1060.why: General single-1060 worker: structured extraction, document prep, QA. Provisional; leads qwen2.5-coder:7b on reasoning, ambiguity, orchestration and long context.
single_1060.evidence: smoke suites 2026-10-19 (full code and l50 reasoning pending); switched 2026-10-20

single_1060_code.why: Code on one 1060: HumanEval+ base 88.4%, plus 84.1%; current BBH flexible 69.3% and runtime 22.57 generation tok/s.
single_1060_code.evidence: role-bbh-qwen7b-retry-20261127; role-runtime-full-gap-20261127; full code 2026-10-18; exact commands in results/model_benchmark_records.jsonl

single_1060_compact.why: Compact speed option at 38.62 generation tok/s; BBH flexible 10.5% limits it to small tasks.
single_1060_compact.evidence: role-bbh-ministral3b-20261127; role-runtime-full-gap-20261127; full code 2026-10-18; exact commands in results/model_benchmark_records.jsonl

text_extraction.why: Text extraction and reading comprehension; current BBH flexible 76.0% and runtime 31.58 generation tok/s; code remains secondary.
text_extraction.evidence: role-bbh-gemmae2b-retry-20261127; role-runtime-full-gap-20261127; full code 2026-10-18; exact commands in results/model_benchmark_records.jsonl

safe_tool_use.why: Command safety and tool sequencing; not for complex reasoning.
